ownerVision.text: Prove Project Game Mode can autonomously evolve a persistent multi-file browser game across bounded milestones without whole-project regeneration.

requirements.statement: The browser game exposes a deterministic power-and-mining core loop that is visibly playable.
Durable game state can be saved through the host-owned persistence bridge, survive a host-page reload, and be restored equivalently.
A later bounded milestone can extend the project while preserving previously verified behavior through inherited regressions.

noGos: Do not regenerate the whole project for a normal task.
Do not modify verification tests from an Engineer task.
Do not use external URLs or runtime assets.
Do not bypass the host-owned persistence bridge.
invariants: Simulation actions are deterministic for identical input state and action.
Mining consumes one unit of power and produces one unit of ore.
Persisted durable state after reload equals the state that was saved.
